messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

set: ["stopping treatment is not automatically safer", "breastfeeding is not recommended during treatment", "long-term treatment is not usually stopped before surgery", "stopping may not be safe", "stopping medication", "stopping Prednisone", "stopping fluoxetine", "starting is not recommended", "do not breastfeed during treatment", "list is not complete", "stop treatment if child is not growing or gaining weight as expected", "is only part of complete treatment program", "maintenance dose is not fixed", "ask doctor for safer medicine during this time", "do not drink alcohol during treatment", "this list is not complete"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
